stories.title: A un año de lucha, vecinos dicen que “están en un sueño”

en.title: After a year of struggle, neighbors say they "are in a dream"
en.summary: Neighbors describe their situation after a year of ongoing struggle, expressing that their circumstances feel unreal or dreamlike.

stories.title: PAN-Edomex pide regular la portación de armas

en.title: PAN-Edomex requests regulation of firearms possession
en.summary: A political party official noted that Mexico has 19 million privately-owned firearms, of which approximately 15 million are carried illegally, leading to calls for regulatory measures.

stories.title: Cae en Cuautla El Trompas, presunto feminicida de estudiante española

en.title: El Trompas, suspected murderer of Spanish student, captured in Cuautla
en.summary: Mexican security authorities arrested Francisco Javier N, suspected of killing Claudia Tacoronte Aguilera, a Spanish exchange student at a university in Morelos state.

stories.title: En Guanajuato, decomiso histórico de 59 millones de litros de huachicol

en.title: Historic 59 million liter fuel theft seizure in Guanajuato
en.summary: Mexican federal and state authorities seized over 59 million liters of illegally-obtained fuel in a single operation in Guanajuato, marking the largest such confiscation in the current administration.

stories.title: FGR investiga megadecomiso de 59 millones de litros de huachicol en Guanajuato; muestra fotos aéreas del complejo

en.title: FGR investigates massive 59 million liter huachicol seizure in Guanajuato; shows aerial photos of complex
en.summary: Mexican authorities are investigating a major illegal fuel seizure involving 59 million liters in Guanajuato state, with aerial photographs documenting the operation site.

stories.title: Ingresan a presunto feminicida de Claudia Tacoronte a penal distrital de Cuautla; esperará audiencia inicial

en.title: Suspected femicide perpetrator of Claudia Tacoronte admitted to Cuautla district prison; awaits initial hearing
en.summary: A suspect arrested in connection with the death of Claudia Tacoronte has been incarcerated and will face an initial court hearing.

stories.title: NFL: Josh Allen lidera a los Buffalo Bills hasta la victoria ante los Detroit Lions

en.title: NFL: Josh Allen leads Buffalo Bills to victory against Detroit Lions
en.summary: The Buffalo Bills improved to 2-0 after defeating the Detroit Lions, while Detroit suffered its first loss of the season.

stories.title: Embiste Josh Allen a los Lions en arranque de Semana 2

en.title: Josh Allen charges into the Lions in Week 2 kickoff
en.summary: Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills defeated the Detroit Lions 41-31 in the opening game of Week 2 of the NFL season.

stories.title: Pobladores de Quechultenango, Guerrero, retienen a 19 militares y policías por más de 5 horas; el lugar es bastión de "Los Ardillos"

en.title: Residents of Quechultenango, Guerrero, detain 19 military and police officers for over 5 hours; the area is a stronghold of "Los Ardillos"
en.summary: Residents in Quechultenango, Guerrero held 19 military and police personnel for more than 5 hours. This follows the discovery of a dismembered National Guard soldier's body in the region in early September.

stories.title: Pobladores retienen a policías y militares en Quechultenango, Guerrero

en.title: Residents detain police and military in Quechultenango, Guerrero
en.summary: Twenty-nine military and police personnel were detained by residents in Quechultenango, Guerrero while conducting routine operations, according to the state government's undersecretary.

stories.title: Fiscal de Morelos pedirá la pena máxima para Francisco Javier "N", presunto feminicida de Claudia Tacoronte; tienen elementos de prueba importantes

en.title: Morelos prosecutor will seek maximum sentence for Francisco Javier "N", alleged femicide perpetrator of Claudia Tacoronte; possess important evidence
en.summary: The prosecutor stated that the alleged motive for the femicide was a cellphone theft and ruled out any sexual assault component. The prosecution has significant evidence in the case.

stories.title: Detienen a presunto feminicida de española en Morelos

en.title: Alleged murderer of Spanish woman arrested in Morelos
en.summary: The suspected perpetrator in the killing of Claudia Tacoronte, a Spanish woman murdered in Cuautla, has been detained.

stories.title: FEMSA conquista México con OXXO, pero su imperio de negocios se extiende de Estados Unidos hasta Europa

en.title: FEMSA conquers Mexico with OXXO, but its business empire extends from the United States to Europe
en.summary: FEMSA operates convenience stores, food and beverage businesses, financial services, and digital solutions across multiple countries beyond Mexico.

stories.title: Si la IA hace el trabajo junior, ¿quién formará a la próxima generación de Wall Street?

en.title: If AI does junior work, who will train the next generation of Wall Street?
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is automating junior analyst tasks, prompting Wall Street to reconsider how it develops financial talent, builds judgment, and oversees AI models.

stories.title: Rodrigo Herrera regresará como CEO interino de Genomma Lab

en.title: Rodrigo Herrera will return as interim CEO of Genomma Lab
en.summary: Mexican entrepreneur Rodrigo Herrera will assume the interim CEO role for 12 to 18 months while the company searches for a permanent chief executive.

stories.title: Esta es la razón por la que tus pedidos de Amazon, Temu y Shein siempre pasan por Cuautitlán Izcalli

en.title: This is the reason why your Amazon, Temu and Shein orders always pass through Cuautitlán Izcalli
en.summary: Cuautitlán Izcalli serves as a strategic logistics corridor in northern Mexico City's valley, connecting highways, industrial parks, and distribution centers that enable shipments from Amazon, Temu, and Shein to reach consumers.
